description: Department of Local Government - Northern Province - Convene the meeting for the election to fill the Vacancy of Chairman of Mannar Pradesiya Sabha in Northern Province
categorisation: This gazette notice announces a meeting for the election to fill the vacancy of Chairman of Mannar Pradeshiya Sabha, which falls under electoral processes and related matters as defined for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes). The content specifically references the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act and concerns the scheduling of an election meeting, making it a clear fit for the elections category rather than government personnel or structural changes.
